notes: AE notes: VerboCare is a mid-to-large contact center platform focusing on multilingual customer support for e-commerce brands.
Primary ask: agent assist + ticket summarization that preserves customer locale and tone; integrate into Zendesk + Twilio + internal CRM via function calls.
Pilot metrics: p50 latency < 400ms for short chat flows, p95 < 1.2s; 10k concurrent chats target during Black Friday style spikes.
They want routing by customer locale (language + country) and currency-aware phrasing (es-AR vs es-MX difference noted).
Security: must support SSO/SAML, KMS-managed keys, audit logs forwarded to their Splunk instance, and EU data residency for EU customers.
Quote from product head: "We need responses that sound local — not generic Castilian for all LATAM. Tone matters for retention."
Integration note: will test Redwood function-calls to hit internal ticket update API and trigger agent side macros; prefer secure VPC peering for private deployment.
Commercial: interested in Dedicated for sustained throughput, Private for EU residency; Optimize to tune batching/quantization to hit cost targets.
Risk: legal needs DPA changes around subprocessor list and 7-year log retention; engineering wants a latency SLO for peak bursts before procurement.
Next: SE to run stress test with synthetic traffic (2026-03-05), Legal review due 2026-03-10.
requirements_summary: Deliver multilingual agent-assist and ticket summarization that is locale-aware (language + regional tone), supports function-calling to update tickets, integrates with Zendesk/Twilio, withstands spikes up to 10k concurrent chats, and complies with SOC2 + EU data residency. Preferred deployment: Dedicated capacity with Private (VPC) option. Success metrics: translation fidelity score > 0.85 on internal test set, p50 latency < 400ms, cost per 1k tokens within target range.
poC_details: 2-week pilot covering en/us, es-mx, pt-br. Data: synthetic + redacted real tickets. Tests: latency under load, translation quality, tone calibration, function-call reliability (ticket updates), routing failover to fallback model.
commercial_notes: Procurement prefers annual commit; initial ARR band target $120k-480k. Legal requested DPA redline; procurement timeline ~Mar 2026. SE to produce cost/throughput options for Dedicated vs Hosted with fallback policies.
